title: Read a URL
summary: A URL identifies a destination. Its scheme, host, path and query parts have different roles.
introduction: A URL identifies a destination. Its scheme, host, path and query parts have different roles. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A URL identifies a destination. Its scheme, host, path and query parts have different roles.

blocks.code:
https://practice.test/books?title=Moon
Scheme: https
Host: practice.test
Path: /books
Query: title=Moon
blocks.title: Read a URL

blocks.text: The query carries a search value. practice.test is a fictional host for reading the example.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Separate the parts of a second fictional URL.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not send requests to a system you are not authorised to use.
For more detail later, use this [Postman further reading](https://learning.postman.com/docs/getting-started/overview/).

seo.title: Postman: Read a URL
seo.description: Learn about read a url in Postman. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
